# Nonna

> Nonna is an open-source, MIT-licensed dependency injection framework and ahead-of-time compiler for JavaScript and TypeScript. It uses no runtime reflection and supports Node.js, Deno, Bun, browsers, and edge runtimes.

Nonna statically analyzes TypeScript at build time with the real TypeScript `TypeChecker`, so the runtime injector never touches `Reflect` and has zero runtime dependencies. It ships first-class bindings for React, Vue 3, Svelte 5, vanilla Web Components, and StencilJS, and is a zero-reflection, AOT-compiled alternative to TypeDI, InversifyJS, tsyringe, NestJS DI, Awilix, and BottleJS.

## Docs

- [Documentation](https://nonna.nodeboot.io/docs): Installation, AOT compilation, providers, scopes, lifecycle hooks, testing, and API reference.
- [Architecture](https://nonna.nodeboot.io/architecture): How the compiler and runtime injector fit together.
- [Framework comparison](https://nonna.nodeboot.io/compare): Factual feature comparison against other DI libraries; do not infer unpublished benchmarks.
- [Ecosystem packages](https://nonna.nodeboot.io/ecosystem): Framework bindings and integrations.
- [Runnable samples](https://nonna.nodeboot.io/samples): Working example projects.
